notes: family: area-majority. Game ends immediately at the end of the turn when a piece reaches the player-count-specific Full Moon space. Final score = Region Scoring Token VP + highest revealed number on each of the 6 player-board tracks. 2-player variant uses same categories with different track values and a neutral third pack (track values are printed on the board, so inputs are entered directly). Region scoring: Control = Den/Pack Wolf/Alpha 1 each, Lair 3; Alphas break ties; top 2 in Control take the region token's higher/lower value.
